paraphrase: Brahmā teaches that this knowledge is not to be given to the unqualified; ignorance is darkness — the body and world — and knowledge is the sun's orb.

paraphrase: 'That sun is Brahman': meditating with the ajapā 'haṃsaḥ so'ham' one sees the self-luminous consciousness.

paraphrase: This is not samādhi, not attainment of yoga, not dissolution of mind — it is oneness with Brahman.
